sequenceReference.note: This package narrows step 3 of the pinned sequence to protocol/readiness only. It does not close step 3; it freezes the contract a later, separately authorized generation package must target byte-identically.

goal: Freeze a declarative typed-action/envelope protocol contract for CreateCustomer@1, derived only from the already-closed CreateCustomerPipeline surface, so a future generated-SDK package has a pinned, deterministic target. Introduces no generator, no generated client, no src/sdk tree and no delivery surface.

createCustomerV1.note: These fields and outcomes are read off the closed CreateCustomerPipeline, not invented here. A future generator must regenerate byte-identically from this pin, never from a redefinition.

errorEnvelope.note: The flat V2-shaped non-allow envelope the pipeline already returns; the SDK's error type has no field beyond these four.

v5DeliveryBlockedUntil: the generated-sdk step of the pinned sequence closes GREEN (this package only narrows it to a protocol contract; it does not close it)
the one-golden-slice step of the pinned sequence closes GREEN
nonGoals: no src/sdk directory or any generated SDK output
no code generator, no generation tooling
no ASGI, Uvicorn or Hypercorn delivery surface
no FastAPI development base; FastAPI stays an optional future adapter host only
no release, deploy or production path
no change to src/application or src/domain source
no readiness, MVP or production claim anywhere in this package

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the pinned protocol contract, the flags block or the non-goals set drifts from this record
